description: Open a live session on one target of an e2e project: loads the config, starts the app command the target declares (if any), boots the engine (a browser, a simulator), opens the app (its URL, or the pinned app on a device), and returns the session id, the catalog of tools it can run, and the first observation. Where the project has no e2e config file, pass engine to open a session on that engine: {engine: "@e2e-dev/web", app: {url: "http://localhost:3000"}}. With test, it runs that one test first and stops on the screen where the test passed or failed, with the failure and its line ahead of the catalog. Several sessions can be open at once, one per agent, each with its own engine: pass the returned session id to every later call. Then act with call and look with call {tool: "observe"}.

app.description: With engine: the app under test, as a target declares it in an e2e.config.ts. @e2e-dev/web needs url; @e2e-dev/mobile needs bundleId or appPath

appPath.description: A build a device installs and launches: an .app, .ipa, or .apk, relative to the server's working directory

bundleId.description: An installed app a device launches: its bundle id, package, or display name

url.description: The URL the session opens, and the base of relative navigation

config.description: Path to an e2e config file, absolute or relative to the server's working directory; default: the nearest e2e.config.ts, .mts, .js, or .mjs

export.description: The export to call; default: the default export

options.description: What the factory is called with, as in an e2e.config.ts. A value of this same {package, export?, options?} shape is called first and replaced by its result

package.description: The package, with a subpath when the factory lives on one: @e2e-dev/mobile, @e2e-dev/testmu/web

engine.description: Only where the project has no config file: the engine to open a session on, as a config would build it. A package name calls its default export with no options: "@e2e-dev/web". An object passes options, and an option can be another factory call, which is how an engine gets a device or browser provider: {package: "@e2e-dev/mobile", options: {platform: "ios"}}, or {package: "@e2e-dev/mobile", options: {platform: "ios", device: {package: "@e2e-dev/limrun", export: "limrun", options: {region: "eu"}}}} for mobile({platform: "ios", device: limrun({region: "eu"})}). A package not installed fails with the command that installs it. Excludes target, config, and test

headed.description: Show the browser or simulator, when the engine supports it; pass true when the user wants to watch. Default: headless, unless the server was started with --headed

target.description: Target name from the config; required when the config declares several

test.description: One test to run in the session first, named the way npx e2e run takes it: tests/checkout.e2e.ts:12, where 12 is the line its test( call is on (not a failing line inside it), or a file or name that selects one test. The session then stays on the screen where the test stopped; afterEach hooks and fixture teardown run at close_session. To rerun after editing the test, close_session and open_session with test again

name: open_session
